model: Vita high-pressure humidification system (Integrated Controller, Modbus RTU/TCP)
applies_to: Condair Vita system with the Integrated Controller, per addendum 2603326-G.
summary: The Condair Vita is a high-pressure nebulising humidification system serving up to 50 areas. Its Integrated Controller is a Modbus RTU slave or Modbus TCP server. This map covers system, RO, deionisation and HP-line states, error flag, code and category, per-area state and humidity, and the per-area humidity setpoints.

addressing.note: Tables print the 5-digit register (32001 = input register, 43001 = holding register) and the 0-based address beside it (2000 / 3000). The address column is what goes on the wire; the manual's own example: register 43004 = address 3003.

source.title: Modbus addendum manual for DL II, ME II, RS II, RO-E and Vita (Integrated Controller)

notes: Input registers are read with function 04; holding registers with 03 and written with 06 or 16.
Floats use 'Register Sequence': MSR first (high register first, ABCD) is the factory setting; LSR first (CDAB) is the option. The map assumes the factory setting.
Factory serial settings: Modbus RTU, address 10, 19200 baud, even parity, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit. Modbus TCP uses port 502 and unit ID 255 (per the TCP technical data).
Units marked metric/imperial follow the controller's Metric/Imperial setting; the listed unit is the metric one.
Left out: UInt32 values (serial number, replacement and error timestamps) because the manual gives the register sequence for floats only.
Left out: area actual temperatures; the range is printed 32651-32751 / 2650-2750 (101 registers) for 50 floats, so the end of the block is unclear.
Area humidity floats are listed two registers per area from 2550, matching the printed 2550-2649 range.

values.3: Error w. impact on water quality

values.0: No errors and no warnings pending

registers.name: System Viewer Err Warn Code
registers.description: 0 = no error; other codes are listed in the device operation manual.

quirks: The address column is the wire address; 32001 is address 2000.
Floats are two registers, MSR first by default.
integration.summary: Read input registers 2000-2009 for system and error state and 2500-2549 for area states; write area setpoints to holding 3500-3549.
integration.enable: Network > Modbus Settings on the controller.
setup: Menu > password 8808 > Network > Modbus Settings: set protocol (Modbus/RTU or Modbus/TCP), address, parity, baud rate and register sequence; the controller restarts after a protocol change.
For Modbus TCP set the IP parameters under Network > IP Settings (factory setting DHCP).
gotchas: Read the error category (2006) together with the error flag; the manual warns that ignoring the category causes needless warning messages.
Wrong setpoints or sensor values can cause water damage; the operator must monitor them.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
